text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fsshhh… Fsshhh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A gentle breeze swirls by the beach at night, and the air is awash with the soothing lull of the waves…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The tranquility is far removed from the chaos of the city. What in the world am I doing here?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's the… OCEEEAAAN!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, hey! This is no time to be a zombie, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All right! On your feet! The time for you to awaken has come!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What? Seriously? You don't remember?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: One fateful day, the sky turned black, and all hope disappeared from the world… or did it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, the universe has me, the great savior of the world, Gold Ship, on their side!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I've crossed oceans and climbed mountains in search of Eden, all so I could save the world!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing the word "Eden" brings back some hazy memories…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …That's right. It all started a few days ago.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I was walking along thinking about the upcoming Twinkle Series when…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Lend me an ear!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I was digging in a field to investigate the bedrock when guess what?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I found the Book of Secrets!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "The land of Eden is a utopia that can only be reached by the Umamusume who wields the ultimate power…"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "I call on thee, O Gold Ship, to seek out Eden! Yours truly, the Book of Secrets."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: This means I'm the chosen Umamusume, right? Right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oooh! I'm pumped!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wait, would the real Book of Secrets sign off with a "yours truly"?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You're doubting the veracity of this book?! The very land of Eden yearns for me! Clearly, you don't understand how important I am!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I didn't want to get rough, but you leave me no choice…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: In you go!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: There, there. You're okay. It's not like I'm gonna chop you up and make a croquette out of you or anything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I must have been dragged off to this place after that…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Anyway. Now that we're here, let's go over what we have to do.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Say, you wouldn't happen to have a compass on you, would you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I mean, we lost everything from our phones to our food while swimming here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So now I don't even know which way home is, much less Eden.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Not gonna lie—I'm not super pumped about living the rest of our lives here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: How did things come to this?!
